articles.summary: SAN DIEGO, July 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Encore Capital Group, Inc. (Nasdaq:ECPG), an international specialty finance company, announced today that it will release its financial results for the second quarter 2026 on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, after the market closes.
articles.title: Encore Capital Group to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 5
